title: U.S. Attorney Who Oversaw Centerpiece of Trump’s Revenge Campaign Resigns
summary: Jason Reding Quiñones joins what is expected to be a succession of departures at the Justice Department after the midterm elections, including that of the leader of the national security division.
body_markdown: Jason Reding Quiñones joins what is expected to be a succession of departures at the Justice Department after the midterm elections, including that of the leader of the national security division.
